text: My name is Jun. I was a roofer before I became a monk. This morning the wind rattled the loose shutter beside my bed, and I lay there hoping it would stop without my help. It did not. I found the small hammer under the stool and went out onto the sheltered ledge. Mara, my old teacher, used to watch me find elaborate reasons to postpone a simple repair. She died some years ago. I still miss her, particularly when I have done something she would have found funny. After fixing the shutter I made tea in the dented kettle. The tea was better than the repair.
